rawFindings.title: Missing child_process error handler causes launcher crash for invalid binaries
rawFindings.explanation: The new code only listens to stderr/close after spawning and no longer attaches an `error` listener to the ChildProcess. On supported Node versions, `spawn()` emits an `error` event (for example `ENOENT`) when the browser executable path is invalid; without a listener this is an unhandled EventEmitter error and terminates Karma instead of reporting a browser process failure.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore a `self._process.on('error', ...)` handler that records the error output and disables retries for `ENOENT` before the process can emit the event.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Set `CHROME_BIN=/no/such/browser` (or otherwise configure a nonexistent browser binary) and launch that browser on Node 0.10+: the ChildProcess emits `error` with `code === 'ENOENT'`, causing an unhandled error and process crash instead of logging the missing binary and aborting gracefully.
